title: Radiology: CT spleen annotation to VISTA3D / U-Net learning

steps.prompt: Create a project called "Radiology golden story"
steps.action: Create a fresh project; targets can be added while annotating.

steps.prompt: Open the dataset import form
steps.action: Import 12 Decathlon spleen NIfTI cases as training and 4 different patients as validation. Use one source group per case. Keep additional cases in the pool.

steps.prompt: Open the API credential form
steps.action: Optional: configure the server environment reference NV_INFERENCE_API_KEY to enable Sol. Never paste a secret into chat. VISTA3D needs no hosted key.

steps.prompt: Show the annotation model connection form
steps.action: Inspect the ready model presets or register a deployed model. Keep VISTA3D base read-only; use Sol as the hosted alternative.

steps.prompt: List the available annotation models
steps.action: Check that VISTA3D and any configured hosted models are listed.

steps.prompt: View this sample in 3D Slicer
steps.action: Select a training sample in Datasets first. Installation is reused or prepared automatically.

steps.prompt: Annotate spleen in the full volume using VISTA3D
steps.action: Wait for the proposal; inspect every slice and correct the segmentation in Segment Editor.

steps.prompt: Annotate liver on this slice using Sol
steps.action: Optional multiclass branch: configure Sol first. The new label is added without removing spleen. Liver training requires complete reviewed liver masks.

steps.prompt: Submit this annotation for review
steps.action: Submit only after checking the whole volume and every project label. A single predicted slice is not complete training evidence.

steps.prompt: Show the pending review queue
steps.action: As reviewer, open the pending sample from the web queue in Slicer.

steps.prompt: Accept my corrected segmentation
steps.action: Inspect or edit in Slicer, then accept. Repeat annotation/submission/review for the training cases and independently review held-out validation labels.

steps.prompt: Create a snapshot of the reviewed dataset
steps.action: Freeze accepted revisions from disjoint training and validation source groups.

steps.prompt: Create a VISTA3D model named "Spleen VISTA tuned" for spleen, initialized from the read-only base for fine-tuning; do not start training yet
steps.action: Creates a separate project learner. The base weights remain unchanged.

steps.prompt: Train the selected project learner
steps.action: Select Spleen VISTA tuned; wait for training to finish. The completed job selects its checkpoint and snapshot in web chat.

steps.prompt: Evaluate the selected candidate against the selected baseline on the current snapshot
steps.action: Select the new checkpoint as candidate and VISTA3D base as evaluation baseline. Both run on the same held-out cases.

steps.prompt: Show the held-out evaluation results
steps.action: Inspect per-target Dice for candidate and baseline, validation cases, and promotion eligibility. An improvement is measured, never assumed.

steps.prompt: Create a U-Net segmentation model named Spleen U-Net for spleen from scratch; do not start training yet
steps.action: Optional alternative learner: 3D scalar layout is inferred from the imported CT data. Repeat train/evaluate with VISTA3D as baseline.

steps.prompt: Continue training the selected model on the reviewed dataset
steps.action: Select a trained U-Net checkpoint and its learner. Add/correct and review training cases first; a new checkpoint keeps the old version intact.

steps.prompt: Compare the selected new model against the selected previous version on the current held-out snapshot
steps.action: Select the earlier U-Net checkpoint as baseline. Keep the same independent validation cases across versions.

steps.prompt: Annotate spleen in the full volume using the selected model
steps.action: Refresh Slicer models, explicitly select the new checkpoint, and try an untouched pool case. Evaluation does not switch project defaults.
